name: Rolled oats
notes: Rolled and quick oats, dry, not fortified, as rolled oats are sold in India. Foundation 2346396 (rolled, old fashioned) has no fibre value, so available carbohydrate would be missing

name: Brown rice (raw)
notes: Long-grain, raw. Brown rice is not enriched. Foundation 2512380 has no saturated fat, sugars or folate value

name: Quinoa (raw)
notes: Uncooked. The record has no sugars or vitamin C value

name: Skimmed milk
aliases: skim milk|skimmed milk|fat free milk|nonfat milk|slim milk
notes: Nonfat, without added vitamins A and D, as nutrition-mcp's whole milk is, because fortification of Indian milk varies by brand

name: Greek yogurt (plain, low fat)
notes: Plain, lowfat (1.9 g fat per 100 g). Greek yogurts come at several fat levels: the whole-milk record (SR 171304) has 5 g fat, the nonfat one (SR 170894) 0.4 g

name: Mozzarella (low moisture, part skim)
notes: Low-moisture, part-skim, the block mozzarella sold for pizza and grating. Tagged veg on the assumption of a microbial or vegetable rennet; cheese set with animal rennet is not vegetarian

name: Whey protein powder
notes: Whey-based protein powder, unflavoured: 78 g protein and 3 g carbohydrate per 100 g. SR 173177, named an isolate, has 29 g carbohydrate and added vitamins A and C, so it is a formulated mix. Flavoured powders add sugar or sweetener that this record does not count

name: Egg white
notes: White of a fresh egg, raw. Foundation 747997 has no mineral or vitamin values

name: Chicken breast (skinless, boneless)
aliases: chicken breast|boneless chicken breast|chicken breast fillet
notes: Broiler breast, skinless and boneless, meat only, raw, without added solution (SR 171509 is the injected kind). Foundation 2646170 has no folate, vitamin A, B12 or vitamin D value

name: Tofu (firm)
notes: Firm tofu set with calcium sulfate and nigari, the more complete of the two SR firm-tofu records. SR 172475 (firm, calcium sulfate only) is a denser tofu with 17 g protein and 683 mg calcium per 100 g against 9 g and 201 mg here; a pack that lists about 15 g protein is closer to it

name: Kela (ripe banana)
notes: Ripe banana, edible part. Green cooking banana is nutrition-mcp's raw_banana. Foundation 1105314 (ripe and slightly ripe) has no saturated fat, B12 or vitamin D value

name: Seb (apple, with skin)
notes: With skin, all varieties. The Foundation apple records are single US varieties and have no saturated fat, vitamin A or vitamin C value

name: Santra (mandarin orange)
notes: Mandarin (Citrus reticulata): santra, Nagpur orange and kinnow are mandarins. Sweet oranges (navel, valencia, malta) are SR 169097, with 47 kcal and 53.2 mg vitamin C per 100 g against 53 kcal and 26.7 mg here

name: Blueberries (frozen, unsweetened)
notes: Frozen, unsweetened. A sweetened pack is SR 173951, with 85 kcal per 100 g against 51

name: Anar (pomegranate)
notes: Edible part: the arils with their seeds

name: Papita (papaya)
notes: Ripe papaya, edible part

name: Shakarkandi (sweet potato)
notes: Raw, orange-fleshed: 709 µg vitamin A (RAE) per 100 g. Sweet potatoes sold in India are often white or pale-fleshed, with much less beta-carotene, so vitamin A reads high for those. The Foundation orange-flesh record (2346404) has no fibre value

name: Broccoli
notes: Raw. Foundation 747447 has no B12 or vitamin D value

name: Mushrooms (white button)
notes: White button mushrooms (Agaricus bisporus), raw, not exposed to UV light. UV-treated mushrooms (SR 169376) have 26.2 µg vitamin D per 100 g against 0.2 here

name: Iceberg lettuce
notes: Iceberg (crisphead), raw. Romaine is SR 169247

name: Patta gobi (cabbage)
notes: Green cabbage, raw. Foundation 2346407 (green) has no fibre value

name: Kimchi (cabbage)
notes: Cabbage kimchi. Neither this record nor the survey record built from it (2710077) says whether it holds fish sauce or salted shrimp, and most kimchi on sale holds one or both, so it is tagged non_veg here and carries fish and crustaceans in the catalogue. A vegan kimchi would need its own row

name: Chia seeds
notes: Dried. The record has no sugars, vitamin A or vitamin D value. Foundation 2710819 has no fibre value, so available carbohydrate would be missing

name: Alsi (flax seeds)
notes: The record lists portions for whole and ground seed. Foundation 2262075 (ground) has no sugars, vitamin A, B12, C or D value

name: Pumpkin seeds
notes: Dried kernels, unroasted and unsalted. Dry-roasted without salt is SR 170557

name: Sunflower seeds
notes: Dried kernels, unroasted and unsalted

name: Til (sesame seeds)
notes: Whole (unhulled) seed, dried. Hulled sesame (SR 169412) has 60 mg calcium per 100 g against 975 mg here, so calcium reads high for a recipe made with hulled til

name: Akhrot (walnuts)
notes: English walnut kernels

name: Badam (almonds)
notes: Whole kernels with skin, raw. Foundation 2346393 has no sugars, folate or vitamin values

name: Peanut butter (smooth, salted)
notes: Smooth, with salt, and with the sugar commercial peanut butter carries: 10.49 g sugars per 100 g against 4.72 g in nutrition-mcp's raw peanuts. The unsalted record (SR 172470) has 17 mg sodium against 426 mg

name: Olive oil
aliases: olive oil|extra virgin olive oil|evoo|pomace olive oil
notes: Salad or cooking olive oil. The Foundation olive oils (748608 extra virgin, 1750351 extra light) have no energy, fat or vitamin values

name: Soy sauce
notes: Brewed from soy and wheat (shoyu), so it carries gluten. Tamari, from soy alone, is SR 174278; a sauce made from hydrolysed vegetable protein is SR 174279

name: Shahad (honey)
notes: Tagged veg rather than vegan, because honey is an animal product that vegans usually leave out
